    }

    public static function maxBy(mixed $items, string $field): float
    {
        $m = 0.0;
        foreach (self::l($items) as $it) {

    /** an inline style from (property, value, unit) triples */
    public static function css(array $triples): string
    {
        $parts = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i + 2 < count($triples); $i += 3) {

            }
            $this->json[$path] = json_decode($text, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        }
        return $this->json[$path];
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- values

    private static function isNum(mixed $v): bool
    {
        return is_int($v) || is_float($v);
    }

    /** a path of fields: get(plan, ['price', 'amount']); `length` of a list or a text is its size */
    public static function get(mixed $v, array $path): mixed
    {
        foreach ($path as $k) {
            $k = (string) $k;
            if (is_array($v)) {
                if (array_is_list($v) && ($k === 'length' || ctype_digit($k))) {
                    if ($k === 'length') {
                        $v = count($v);
                    } else {
                        $v = $v[(int) $k] ?? null;
                    }
                } else {
                    $v = $v[$k] ?? null;
                }
            } elseif (is_string($v) && $k === 'length') {
                $v = mb_strlen($v);
            } else {
                return null;
            }
        }
        return $v;
    }

    /** a field of a brick record (BreadcrumbItem): the JSON key matched without regard to case, as Go json does */
    public static function field(mixed $item, string $name, mixed $zero): mixed
    {
        if (!is_array($item)) {
            return $zero;
        }
        if (array_key_exists($name, $item)) {
            return $item[$name] ?? $zero;
        }
        foreach ($item as $k => $v) {
            if (strcasecmp((string) $k, $name) === 0) {
                return $v ?? $zero;
            }
        }
        return $zero;
    }

    /** String(n) of JavaScript for the numbers the views print: 3, 2.5, -1 */
    public static function fmtNum(int|float $f): string
    {
        if (is_int($f)) {
            return (string) $f;
        }
        if (is_nan($f)) {
            return 'NaN';
        }
        if (is_infinite($f)) {
            return $f > 0 ? 'Infinity' : '-Infinity';
        }
        if ($f == floor($f) && abs($f) < 1e21) {
            return sprintf('%.0f', $f);
        }
        return json_encode($f);
    }

    public static function s(mixed $v): string
    {
        if ($v === null) {
            return '';
        }
        if (is_string($v)) {
            return $v;
        }
        if (is_bool($v)) {
            return $v ? 'true' : 'false';
        }
        if (self::isNum($v)) {
            return self::fmtNum($v);
        }
        if ($v instanceof \Stringable) {
            return (string) $v;
        }
        return json_encode($v, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
    }

    /** what a text node shows: nothing for null and booleans */
    public static function text(mixed $v): string
    {
        return is_bool($v) ? '' : self::s($v);
    }

    /** JS truthiness: null, false, 0, NaN and '' are false */
    public static function t(mixed $v): bool
    {
        if ($v === null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (is_bool($v)) {
            return $v;
        }
        if (is_string($v)) {
            return $v !== '';
        }
        if (self::isNum($v)) {
            return $v != 0 && !is_nan((float) $v);
        }
        if ($v instanceof \Stringable) {
            return (string) $v !== '';
        }
        return true;
    }

    /** Number(v) */
    public static function n(mixed $v): float
    {
        if (self::isNum($v)) {
            return (float) $v;
        }
        if (is_string($v) && is_numeric(trim($v))) {
            return (float) trim($v);
        }
        if (is_bool($v)) {
            return $v ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        }
        return 0.0;
    }

    /** an int for an int prop of a brick */
    public static function i(mixed $v): int
    {
        return (int) round(self::n($v));
    }

    /** strict equality (===) */
    public static function eq(mixed $a, mixed $b): bool
    {
        $na = self::isNum($a);
        $nb = self::isNum($b);
        if ($na || $nb) {
            return $na && $nb && (float) $a == (float) $b;
        }
        if ($a === null || is_string($a) || is_bool($a)) {
            return $a === $b;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static function cmp(mixed $a, mixed $b): ?int
    {
        if (is_string($a) && is_string($b)) {
            return strcmp($a, $b) <=> 0;
        }
        if ($a === null || $b === null) {
            return null;
        }
        return self::n($a) <=> self::n($b);
    }

    public static function lt(mixed $a, mixed $b): bool { $c = self::cmp($a, $b); return $c !== null && $c < 0; }
    public static function gt(mixed $a, mixed $b): bool { $c = self::cmp($a, $b); return $c !== null && $c > 0; }
    public static function le(mixed $a, mixed $b): bool { $c = self::cmp($a, $b); return $c !== null && $c <= 0; }
    public static function ge(mixed $a, mixed $b): bool { $c = self::cmp($a, $b); return $c !== null && $c >= 0; }

    /** `a + b`: text when either side is text, else a sum */
    public static function add(mixed $a, mixed $b): string|float
    {
        if (is_string($a) || is_string($b)) {
            return self::s($a) . self::s($b);
        }
        return self::n($a) + self::n($b);
    }
    public static function sub(mixed $a, mixed $b): float { return self::n($a) - self::n($b); }
    public static function mul(mixed $a, mixed $b): float { return self::n($a) * self::n($b); }
    public static function div(mixed $a, mixed $b): float { return fdiv(self::n($a), self::n($b)); }

    /** the first falsy operand, else the last (JS &&) */
    public static function and(array $vs): mixed
    {
        $last = null;
        foreach ($vs as $v) {
            if (!self::t($v)) {
                return $v;
            }
            $last = $v;
        }
        return $last;
    }

    /** the first truthy operand, else the last (JS ||) */
    public static function or(array $vs): mixed
    {
        $last = null;
        foreach ($vs as $v) {
            if (self::t($v)) {
                return $v;
            }
            $last = $v;
        }
        return $last;
    }

    public static function coalesce(array $vs): mixed
    {
        foreach ($vs as $v) {
            if ($v !== null) {
                return $v;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** a prop with its default: the default when the prop is null */
    public static function def(mixed $v, mixed $d): mixed
    {
        return $v ?? $d;
    }

    /** a list to loop over; null and other values are empty */
    public static function l(mixed $v): array
    {
        return is_array($v) && array_is_list($v) ? $v : [];
    }

    public static function len(mixed $v): int
    {
        if (is_string($v)) {
            return mb_strlen($v);
        }
        return count(self::l($v));
    }

    /** a literal group with the fields of a named group first (`{ ...BASE, mode: "two" }`) */
    public static function spread(mixed $base, array $fields): array
    {
        $out = is_array($base) && !array_is_list($base) ? $base : [];
        foreach ($fields as $k => $v) {
            $out[$k] = $v;
        }
        return $out;
    }

    /** String(x) with undefined kept undefined */
    public static function str(mixed $v): ?string
    {
        return $v === null ? null : self::s($v);
    }

    public static function has(mixed $v): bool
    {
        return $v !== null;
    }

    /** cn over values: clsx skips the falsy ones, tailwind-merge resolves conflicts */
    public static function cnv(array $vs): string
    {
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($vs as $v) {
            if (self::t($v)) {
                $parts[] = self::s($v);
            }
        }
        return CnMerge::merge($parts);
    }

    /** {0}, {1}... of a content template */
    public static function tpl(mixed $t, array $vals): string
    {
        return preg_replace_callback('/\{(\d+)\}/', fn ($m) => (int) $m[1] < count($vals) ? self::s($vals[(int) $m[1]]) : '', self::s($t));
    }

    private static function group(float $f, int $decimals): string
    {
        $s = number_format(abs($f), $decimals, '.', '');
        [$int, $frac] = array_pad(explode('.', $s, 2), 2, '');
        $out = '';
        $n = strlen($int);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            if ($i > 0 && ($n - $i) % 3 === 0) {
                $out .= ',';
            }
            $out .= $int[$i];
        }
        $frac = rtrim($frac, '0');
        if ($frac !== '') {
            $out .= '.' . $frac;
        }
        if ($f < 0 && $out !== '0') {
            $out = '-' . $out;
        }
        return $out;
    }

    /** Intl.NumberFormat("en-US"): grouped, up to 3 decimals */
    public static function num(mixed $v): string
    {
        return self::group(self::n($v), 3);
    }

    private const CURRENCY = ['USD' => '$', 'EUR' => "\u{20AC}", 'GBP' => "\u{00A3}", 'JPY' => "\u{00A5}", 'INR' => "\u{20B9}", 'CAD' => 'CA$', 'AUD' => 'A$'];

    /** Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {style: "currency", maximumFractionDigits: 0}) */
    public static function money(mixed $amount, mixed $currency): string
    {
        $c = self::s($currency);
        $sym = self::CURRENCY[$c] ?? $c . "\u{00A0}";
        $f = round(self::n($amount));
        return $f < 0 ? '-' . $sym . self::group(-$f, 0) : $sym . self::group($f, 0);
    }

    /** a content word by key, the key itself when the dictionary has no entry */
    public static function at(mixed $dict, mixed $key): string
    {
        $v = self::get($dict, [self::s($key)]);
        return $v !== null ? self::s($v) : self::s($key);
    }

    /** the pages a pager shows: the first, the last and the neighbours of the current one; null is a gap */
    public static function pageWindow(mixed $pageV, mixed $pagesV): array
    {
        $page = (int) self::n($pageV);
        $pages = (int) self::n($pagesV);
        $keep = [];
        foreach ([1, $pages, $page - 1, $page, $page + 1] as $n) {
            if ($n >= 1 && $n <= $pages) {
                $keep[$n] = true;
            }
        }
        $out = [];
        $prev = 0;
        for ($n = 1; $n <= $pages; $n++) {
            if (!isset($keep[$n])) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($n - $prev > 1) {
                $out[] = null;
            }
            $out[] = $n;
            $prev = $n;
        }
        return $out;
    }

    /** a responsive column variant capped by the number of items: ("1-4", 3) -> "1-3" */
    public static function fitCols(mixed $colsV, mixed $nV): string
    {
        $cols = self::s($colsV);
        $n = (int) self::n($nV);
        if (!preg_match('/^(-?\d+)-(-?\d+)$/', $cols, $m)) {
            return $cols;
        }
        [$l, $h] = [(int) $m[1], (int) $m[2]];
        if ($n >= $h) {
            return $cols;
        }
        $top = max($l, $n);
        $known = ['1-2', '1-3', '1-4', '2-3', '2-4', '2-6', '3-6'];
        for ($k = $top; $k > $l; $k--) {
            if (in_array("$l-$k", $known, true)) {
                return "$l-$k";
            }
        }
        return (string) min(max($n, 1), $l);
    }

    /** drops a segment of a ", " label equal (case-insensitive) to the one before it */
    public static function uniq(mixed $v): string
    {
        $parts = explode(', ', self::s($v));
        $out = [];
        foreach ($parts as $i => $s) {
            if ($i === 0 || strcasecmp($s, $parts[$i - 1]) !== 0) {
                $out[] = $s;
            }
        }
        return implode(', ', $out);
    }

    public static function words(mixed $v): array
    {
        return explode(' ', self::s($v));
    }

    public static function nbsp(mixed $v): string
    {
        return str_replace(' ', "\u{00A0}", self::s($v));
    }

    public static function nth(mixed $list, mixed $i): mixed
    {
        $l = self::l($list);
        $n = (int) self::n($i);
        return $n >= 0 && $n < count($l) ? $l[$n] : null;
    }

    public static function range(mixed $n): array
    {
        $c = (int) self::n($n);
        return $c > 0 ? range(0, $c - 1) : [];
    }

    public static function max(array $vs): float
    {
        $m = -INF;
        foreach ($vs as $v) {
            $m = max($m, self::n($v));
        }
        return $m;
    }

    public static function min(array $vs): float
    {
        $m = INF;
        foreach ($vs as $v) {
            $m = min($m, self::n($v));
        }
        return $m;
    }

    /** Math.round (halves up) */
    public static function round(mixed $v): float
    {
        return floor(self::n($v) + 0.5);
    }

    public static function count(mixed $items, mixed $field): int
    {
        $n = 0;
        foreach (self::l($items) as $it) {
            if (self::t(self::get($it, [self::s($field)]))) {
                $n++;
            }
        }
        return $n;
    }

    public static function where(mixed $items, mixed $field, mixed $value): array
    {
        if (!self::t($value)) {
            return self::l($items);
        }
        return array_values(array_filter(self::l($items), fn ($it) => self::eq(self::get($it, [self::s($field)]), $value)));
    }

    public static function match(mixed $items, mixed $field, mixed $query): array
    {
        if (!self::t($query)) {
            return self::l($items);
        }
        $q = mb_strtolower(self::s($query));
        return array_values(array_filter(self::l($items), fn ($it) => str_contains(mb_strtolower(self::s(self::get($it, [self::s($field)]))), $q)));
    }

    public static function pick(mixed $items, mixed $id): mixed
    {
        foreach (self::l($items) as $it) {
            if (self::eq(self::get($it, ['id']), $id)) {
                return $it;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static function sumBy(mixed $items, string $a, string $b): float
    {
        $s = 0.0;
        foreach (self::l($items) as $it) {
            $s += self::n(self::get($it, [$a])) * self::n(self::get($it, [$b]));
        }
        return $s;
    }

    public static function firstOf(mixed $items, string $field): mixed
    {
        $l = self::l($items);
        return $l ? (self::get($l[0], [$field]) ?? '') : '';
    }

    public static function maxBy(mixed $items, string $field): float
    {
        $m = 0.0;
        foreach (self::l($items) as $it) {
            $m = max($m, self::n(self::get($it, [$field])));
        }
        return $m;
    }

    /** an inline style from (property, value, unit) triples */
    public static function css(array $triples): string
    {
        $parts = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i + 2 < count($triples); $i += 3) {
            $parts[] = self::s($triples[$i]) . ':' . self::s($triples[$i + 1]) . self::s($triples[$i + 2]);
        }
        return implode(';', $parts);
    }

    /** the class string of a recipe table for a selection (organisms: base, each key, the matching compounds) */
    public function recipe(string $path, array $sel): string
    {
        $r = $this->json($path);
        $pick = function (string $k) use ($r, $sel): string {
            $v = trim(self::s($sel[$k] ?? null));
            return $v !== '' ? $v : trim((string) ($r['defaults'][$k] ?? ''));
        };
        $parts = [(string) ($r['base'] ?? '')];
        foreach ($r['keys'] ?? [] as $k) {
            $parts[] = (string) ($r['byKey'][$k][$pick($k)] ?? '');
        }
        foreach ($r['compound'] ?? [] as $c) {
            if (self::compoundHits($c, $pick)) {
                $parts[] = (string) ($c['class'] ?? '');
            }
        }
        return CnMerge::merge(array_filter(array_map('trim', $parts), fn ($p) => $p !== ''));
    }

    private static function compoundHits(array $c, callable $pick): bool
    {
        foreach ($c as $k => $want) {
            if ($k === 'class') {
                continue;
            }
            if (!in_array($pick((string) $k), explode('|', (string) $want), true)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    /** a preset value of the kit */
    public function preset(string $path, array $keys): mixed
    {
        return self::get(self::get($this->json($path), ['values']), $keys);
    }

    /** free DOM attributes from (name, value) pairs, as React prints them */
    public static function attrs(array $kv): array
    {
        $out = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i + 1 < count($kv); $i += 2) {
            $k = self::s($kv[$i]);
            $v = $kv[$i + 1];
            if ($v === null) {
                continue;
            }
            if (is_bool($v)) {
                if (str_starts_with($k, 'data-') || str_starts_with($k, 'aria-')) {
                    $out[$k] = self::s($v);
                } elseif ($v) {
                    $out[$k] = true;
                }
                continue;
            }
            $out[$k] = self::s($v);
        }
        return $out;
    }

    /** an attribute map as markup (` name="value"`, a bare name for true, nothing for null and false) */
    public static function attrHtml(mixed $attrs): string
    {
        if (!is_array($attrs)) {
            return '';
        }
        $out = '';
        foreach ($attrs as $k => $v) {
            if ($v === null || $v === false) {
                continue;
            }
            $name = htmlspecialchars((string) $k, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8');
            $out .= $v === true ? " $name" : " $name=\"" . htmlspecialchars(self::s($v), ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8') . '"';
        }
        return $out;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- bricks (expr.go, utils.go, tags.go)

    public static function isSetStr(mixed $v): bool
    {
        return trim(self::s($v)) !== '';
    }

    public static function defaultIfEmpty(mixed $v, string $fallback): string
    {
        $t = trim(self::s($v));
        return $t === '' ? $fallback : $t;
    }

    /** a decision table over a trimmed text: mapping[trim(v)] or the fallback */
    public static function mapOr(mixed $v, array $mapping, string $fallback, bool $lower = false): string
    {
        $t = trim(self::s($v));
        if ($lower) {
            $t = strtolower($t);
        }
        return array_key_exists($t, $mapping) ? (string) $mapping[$t] : $fallback;
    }

    public static function intMapOr(mixed $v, array $mapping, string $fallback): string
    {
        $n = self::i($v);
        return array_key_exists($n, $mapping) ? (string) $mapping[$n] : $fallback;
    }

    public static function boolStr(mixed $v): string
    {
        return self::t($v) ? 'true' : 'false';
    }

    public static function concatTrim(array $parts): string
    {
        return implode('', array_map(fn ($p) => trim(self::s($p)), $parts));
    }

    /** class fragments merged with tailwind-merge (strings only, empty ones skipped) */
    public static function cn(array $parts): string
    {
        return CnMerge::merge(array_map(fn ($p) => self::s($p), $parts));
    }

    /** the brick class contract: recipe base, the selected variants (defaults for empty), compounds, then the tail */
    public function compose(string $path, array $selection, array $extra): string
    {
        $r = $this->json($path);
        $parts = [];
        if (trim((string) ($r['base'] ?? '')) !== '') {
            $parts[] = trim((string) $r['base']);
        }
        $pick = function (string $k) use ($r, $selection): string {
            $c = trim(self::s($selection[$k] ?? null));
            return $c !== '' ? $c : trim((string) ($r['defaults'][$k] ?? ''));
        };
        foreach ($r['keys'] ?? [] as $key) {
            $choices = $r['byKey'][$key] ?? null;
            if ($choices === null) {
                continue;
            }
            $choice = $pick($key);
            if ($choice === '') {
                if ($choices) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException("[compose] missing default for key $key");
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (isset($choices[$choice]) && trim((string) $choices[$choice]) !== '') {
                $parts[] = (string) $choices[$choice];
            }
        }
        foreach ($r['compound'] ?? [] as $c) {
            if (self::compoundHits($c, $pick) && trim((string) ($c['class'] ?? '')) !== '') {
                $parts[] = (string) $c['class'];
            }
        }
        return self::cn([...$parts, ...$extra]);
    }

    /** the tag of a primitive: the requested one when the allow-list has it, else the fallback */
    public static function resolveTag(mixed $tag, string $fallback, array $allowed): string
    {
        $t = strtolower(trim(self::s($tag)));
        return $t !== '' && in_array($t, $allowed, true) ? $t : $fallback;
    }

    /** h1-h6 from a level, h2 by default */
    public static function titleTag(mixed $level): string
    {
        $n = self::i($level);
        return $n >= 1 && $n <= 6 ? "h$n" : 'h2';
    }

    /** the inner markup of a Lucide glyph: its nodes with attributes in name order (circle for an unknown name) */
    public function lucide(mixed $name): string
    {
        $icons = $this->json('ui/lucide-icon/lucide-icons.json')['icons'];
        $nodes = $icons[self::s($name)] ?? $icons['circle'];
        $out = '';
        foreach ($nodes as [$tag, $attrs]) {
            ksort($attrs, SORT_STRING);
            $out .= '<' . $tag;
            foreach ($attrs as $k => $v) {
                $out .= ' ' . $k . '="' . htmlspecialchars((string) $v, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8') . '"';
            }
            $out .= '></' . $tag . '>';
        }
        return $out;
    }
